reason: Batch of independently reviewed PRs, each green on its own: #1043: Brings the GUI's follow-up queue and model/tool choices to the paired terminal client: numbered /queue with add (held for later when idle), edit, move up/down/first/last, remove, retry, pause/resume/clear and 'Send one now'; /now stop-and-send (pause, enqueue first, cancel, resume); /model through Core's checked runtime switch also from a harness, with unverified-model verification, one 409 retry and deferred-activation notice; chat choices remembered as project assistant defaults and applied to new chats; /mcp delivery states, tool-schema mode and next-turn exclusions; 'Always allow' standing tool-result consent saved on the runtime; harness session resume for new harness chats; remove-all attachments. Rebased on main 22b46bf (after #1038 and batch 2); shared docs, catalog and packaging entries keep both features. Selected: the new followups unit contracts, shell and TUI suites, the client wheel allowlist (new module), two new real paired TLS LAN Core PTY journeys, the product-knowledge search and Chroma digest sync, the settings-catalog terminal test, and existing real-Core cases for the slash menu, settings saves and the multi-select skills/MCP picker with saved readback. #1045: Stacked on #1043 (follow-up queue and model choices), rebased on main 22b46bf after #1038 and batch 2; the selection is the union of both PRs because this diff against main includes #1043. Fixes a terminal client bug and adds GUI goal, approval and subagent controls. /goal complete always failed with 'Core (422): completion requires a summary and evidence' because the TUI sent the running goal's empty completion_evidence; Core's validation is correct and the GUI is unaffected (it requires summary and evidence before enabling Confirm). The TUI now asks for evidence items and sends them as operator_confirmation, and retries a goal action once on a moved revision. Adds /goal child and child-goal listing; subagent approvals, edited arguments and SSH always-allow in /approvals; subagent status, open, stop and stop-all in /agents; and opens subagent and child-goal conversations. Selected: the new agents unit contracts, the shell suite (approval rows), a real paired TLS LAN Core PTY journey (child goal and completion with evidence), the product-knowledge search and Chroma digest sync, the settings-catalog terminal test, and the remembered-chat real-Core case for the open_view change. #1050: Stacked on #1045 and #1043, rebased on main 22b46bf after #1038 and batch 2; the selection is the union of the three PRs because this diff against main includes them. Fixes archived projects showing as active in the terminal (the picker filtered by metadata.archived_at, a chat marker Core never sets on projects; the rail and startup restore did not filter) and adds the GUI's project management: create with client name, Core-host folder and Host/Docker mode; Archived projects with restore and permanent delete (If-Match); /project rename, relink, execution mode and command policy (whole-policy write, Host confirmation, degrades when Core has no command runtime), network scope (whole-scope write, confirmations for wide access) and archive. Selected: the new projects unit contracts, shell and TUI suites (picker and rail), the client wheel allowlist (new module), a real paired TLS LAN Core PTY journey (create, rename, policy unavailability, scope, archive, restore, delete), the product-knowledge search and Chroma digest sync, the settings-catalog terminal test, and existing real-Core cases for the project picker (child project) and remembered-chat restore. #1052: Stacked on #1050, #1045 and #1043 (restacked on main 22b46bf after #1038 and batch 2); their commits are included until they merge, so the selection is the union of all four PRs. Adds the GUI's project tool follow-up (after-tool assistant) and Docker-mode VPN route to the terminal /project menu: suggest-next-steps and take-notes toggles, analysis runtime from enabled project providers/harnesses with models limited to the provider allowlist or harness models, cloud runtimes only when they permit sensitive data and with explicit cloud confirmation, whole-config PUT with the engagement revision and readback; VPN route via the whole-policy PUT, network forced on with a VPN, cleared when network is turned off, refused in Host mode. Also carries #1050, #1045 and #1043. Selected: both projects unit suites, shell and TUI suites, the client wheel allowlist, both real paired TLS LAN Core PTY journeys (/project management and tool follow-up), both product-knowledge tests, the settings-catalog terminal test, and the existing project-picker and remembered-chat real-Core cases. #1060: After Core accepts a mutation with a 202 receipt, the terminal client reads GET /runtime/requests/{id}/response until the result is ready. A 429 (viewer capacity busy) or 503 (delivery briefly unavailable) on that read reached check_response and raised a plain 'Core (429)', dropping the saved request's ID although the request was saved. The async and sync receipt loops and the accepted-stream loop now treat an unmarked or 'pending' 429/503 as not yet, honour Retry-After until the 120 s deadline, and then raise AcceptedRequest with the command ID; X-Nebula-Request-State complete/needs-reconciliation answers are still final. Selected: the terminal transport suite (new tests for async, sync and stream paths) and the legacy receipt suite that shares the sync helper. #1061: #939 made ChatService.continue_after_tool_callback a coroutine, but AutomationRuntimeManager._finalize_process still called the bound process terminal observer without awaiting it. When a background run_command ended without posting its results webhook (exit, timeout or cancel), the wake coroutine was dropped ('coroutine ... was never awaited'): the chat stayed in WAITING_CALLBACK until the 15 s chat schedule loop's recovery pass resumed it, and the try/except that records runtime.background_process_owner_notify_failed could never fire. Finalization now awaits the observer through call_async (coroutine wakes and plain-function test observers both work). Selected: the whole results-webhook suite, where seven tests of this path were left un-awaited by #939 (start_provider_turn, accept_results, continue_after_tool_callback, _turn_history, sync prepare_resume/start_provider_turn stubs) and failed on main; they are repaired, the producer-ends-without-callback test now proves the wake, and two new tests drive the kernel's own observer binding (create_app) and the failure-recording path; with the branch's test file, all 11 non-regression tests pass on origin/main source and the 3 regressions fail there with the never-awaited warning. Also the restart-recovery background-command cases (shutdown interrupts without waking owners, interrupted producer releases the wait, shutdown parks a driven turn) and the operator Stop case, which now binds the chat's coroutine wake like the kernel so it proves Stop is not blocked by the awaited wake (fails on main with the unraisable never-awaited warning under CI flags), and the automation-runtime cases that run, cancel, time out and finalize commands, all of which pass on origin/main. #1062: Core retired a project's execution worker as soon as the project had no open chat or queued/running work, so every routed request on a quiet project (rename, archive, delete, first chat after a pause) paid a worker cold start and the next one paid it again. Workers now stay until a bounded grace (5 min, NEBULA_IDLE_WORKER_GRACE_SECONDS 0..3600) after the project's last accepted command, and the grace ends at once while another project that still wants a worker has a failed admission waiting to retry (#1030's _admission_retry). Selected: Work batch and admission tests (new grace test, override bounds test, updated edit/delete admission test), quiescence and automatic recovery suites, and product help discovery (new test) because docs/CLI.md and docs/MEMORY_BUDGETS.md describe the grace.
